To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Pax7 is expressed not only in the trunk neural tube, but also in the trunk neural ectoderm and neural crest.

Pax7 is expressed at the trunk level in the dorsal nonneural ectoderm, in the neural crest cells migrating along the dorsolateral and ventral routes and in the neural crest derived melanocyte precursors.
Pax7 is expressed during early development of the trunk neural crest and in its melanocyte and glial lineages.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the expression of Pax3/PAX7 in early trunk NC and its melanocyte lineage, and with their evolutionary conservation in amniote species.
the evolution of neural crest and its derivatives in vertebrates.
the expression of the paired-box transcription factor Pax7 in neural crest cells, which are a major source of peripheral neurons and glial cells.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Pax3 and Pax 7 are expressed by the trunk neural crest and that their expression patterns are conserved among amniotes.

Pax3 and Pax3/Pax6/Pax7 are expressed in neural crest cells, but Pax3 and Pax6 are not in the neural crest melanocyte precursors, whereas the expression of Pax3/P7 in the trunk neural-crest-derived glia and neurons is still controversial.
Pax3 is expressed in the neural crest, in melanocyte and non-neural crest-derived precursors, whereas Pax7 is expressed exclusively in the trunk neural crests.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Pax3/Pax6 and Pax3/Pax8 are expressed in the melanoblasts of the chick and the mouse, whereas only Pax3 is expressed in the melanocyte lineages of the rat, and Pax7 is not expressed at all.
Pax7 is a novel marker of the trunk neural crest and is downregulated in its melanocyte and other non-melanocyte derivatives.
the Pax3/Pax 7 expression pattern in the neural crest is highly conserved in vertebrates, and Pax7 is expressed earlier in trunk neural crest cells than in the Pax3 expression pattern.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Pax7 expression in the trunk neural crests of amniotes may be a conserved feature, but the expression of Pax3 in the trunk neural-crest cells may be restricted to avians.
Pax7 is a novel marker for the trunk neural crest in chick embryos.
the neural crest-derived melanocyte lineage is characterized by a transient Pax3 expression in chick and quails, but by a persistent Pax3 expression in mouse and rat.
